title: World definition
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines a single playable sector: its name and the list of entities to spawn at load time. See ADR-0019 and ADR-0020.

format_version.description: Integer schema version. Must be 1. Increment when the shape changes in a breaking way.

name.description: Human-readable sector name shown in loading screens.

player_ship.description: Spawn parameters for the player-controlled ship.

ship_spawn.description: Spawn parameters for a single ship entity.

position.description: Initial world position in metres (x, y, z). The coordinate system is right-handed, +Y up, -Z forward per ADR-0006. Positions are always in metres; no unit wrapper is needed here.

facing.description: Initial facing direction as a unit vector (x, y, z). Defaults to -Z (forward per ADR-0006).
